audience: database engineers who review branches, schemas and deploy requests in PlanetScale

useCases.title: See databases and their branches
useCases.text: List the organizations, then the databases of one. Read a database's state, default branch and regions, and list its branches.

useCases.title: Read a branch schema and its backups
useCases.text: Read the CREATE statements of a branch, without table data. List the backups of a branch with their state and time.

useCases.title: Review open deploy requests
useCases.text: List the schema change deploy requests of a database. Open one to read its state, diff summary and deployment status.

useCases.title: Create a development branch
useCases.text: Create a development branch from a parent branch, main by default. The branch uses billable resources, and production does not change.

useCases.title: Open a deploy request for review
useCases.text: Open a deploy request that merges schema changes from one branch into another. A person still reviews and deploys it.

useCases.title: List regions and branch details
useCases.text: List the public regions with their cloud providers. Read one branch's ready state, parent branch and region.
